analysis.headline: Summary omits the specific cause of non-payment (husband cancelled the Direct Debit by mistake during divorce), which the Specific Cause Rule requires.

claims.text: The agent checked affordability and the customer’s understanding, and the customer agreed to pay £205 through the online portal on 27 October.

The 'understanding' check is partly inferred from the customer repeating the plan back (T21) and the agent confirming it (T22).

omissions.title: Specific cause of non-payment not reported
omissions.detail: Customer explained her husband cancelled the Direct Debit from the joint account by mistake during their divorce. The Specific Cause Rule requires this.
omissions.suggested_wording: The missed payment arose because the customer's husband cancelled the Direct Debit by mistake from the joint account due to a divorce mix-up.
